title: Bomb threat forces airliner from Tel Aviv to divert to Bulgaria
summary: A bomb threat against an Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv to Vienna on Sunday forced the plane to divert to Bulgaria, according to Bulgarian authorities and the airline.
